rule: Every note under brain/ (brain/*.md) is either linked from a page below (pages), or is a record: a registration and its result, a hand-off or a snapshot, with nothing for a reader to do or run (records, with the reason). A note with instructions that go beyond the steps its page already shows, or that sends the reader to a rig run to do and return, MUST be linked from the page it applies to; runs that belong to no page go under server.html with kind rig. tools/ship/pageNotes-selfcheck.mjs fails a new note that is neither. Each page that is listed shows the row through ui/pageNotesMount.mjs.
